behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer; the window reads one qword at field+0

branches.base_path: v is neither of the three magic constants: return (rdi, 0x5676c20)
branches.neg_overflow_path: v == 0x8000000000000000: neg overflows, jo taken: return (rdi+8, 0x5676ba8)

behavior.output_shape: one (rax, rdx) pair per path, then ret; rax is 0 on the two tag paths, rdi or rdi+8 on the pointer paths

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_slots_note: one R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend; the file stores 0 in the .data.rel.ro slot, applied only at load time
